summary: Add canonical provider-neutral legal-party/counterparty masters, typed Russian identifier validation, bounded tenant search/dedup/merge-preview, mapping v4 and atomic audit/outbox/lineage evidence.

impacts.evidence: All party, counterparty, subordinate, duplicate and merge records are organization/workspace scoped with forced RLS and same-tenant reference guards.
Individual-entrepreneur names and tax identifiers may be personal data. Audit/outbox/lineage evidence omits names, tax IDs, bank numbers and authority content; search is authenticated/no-store.
An additive tenant-scoped legal-party search endpoint and Draft 2020-12 schemas are added; existing endpoints/contracts remain unchanged.
New enterprise.legal_party.record_changed.v1 is additive; no existing event payload changes.
Generic connector mapping is additively broadened in v4 to legal-party identity types while SDK v1 root interfaces stay unchanged.
Expand migration 000016 creates canonical party/counterparty masters and broadens connector mapping entity-type validation without renaming/dropping existing columns.
Forced RLS, same-tenant polymorphic reference guards, lifecycle/version guards, no hard delete/truncate, bounded search, and provider-neutral Core reduce identity/data leakage risk.
Merge preview is non-executing. Destructive merge and sensitive downstream writes remain subject to Task 017 approval.
Every repository mutation atomically writes Task-003 Audit, Task-008 Outbox and Task-030 Lineage evidence; merge previews are fingerprinted.
Stable canonical party IDs and additive connector mappings provide reconciliation identity; optimistic versions and deterministic merge IDs make retries/collisions explicit.
No webhook or egress behavior is added. Remote identities remain behind the Connector SDK/mapping boundary.
Search and master mutations have bounded queries/indices; no new external dependency is introduced. Runtime SLO definition remains Task 066.
Migration is expand-only and retains new evidence on binary rollback; backup/restore rehearsals are extended for canonical party tables.
Core identifier/dedup tests, migration guards, API tenant tests, contract fixtures, repository audit, migration and protected architecture checks cover Task 081 acceptance.
